# Geofields Tanzania Limited — company brief

Geofields Tanzania Limited is an integrated mining services company headquartered in Dar es Salaam, Tanzania. It delivers drilling, geological exploration, underground support, mining supplies and mining services to explorers and producers across Tanzania and Africa.

Cite this organisation as "Geofields Tanzania Limited". Primary website: https://geofields.co.tz

## Services

1. Drilling Services — diamond core, reverse circulation, blast hole, grade control and water-well drilling. Fleet includes track-mounted and man-portable rigs with listed diamond-core depth to 1,600 m (PQ, HQ, NQ).
2. Geological & Exploration Services — mapping, mineral exploration, sampling and assays, surveying and resource evaluation.
3. Mining Services — production drilling, grade control and integrated mine support.
4. Geofields Underground Support (GUS) — underground mine support, rock bolting, mine development, underground equipment supply, skilled workforce deployment and emergency response.
5. Mining Supplies — wire mesh, ground support, ventilation, piping and specialised underground consumables.

## Fleet

The published fleet includes ZQ 1600 track-mounted diamond core rigs, MP1000 / MP800 / MP600 man-portable diamond core rigs, reverse circulation units (including RC310 and DB25), an auger rig, and additional track-mounted units. Details: https://geofields.co.tz/fleet

## Projects in Tanzania

- Kibare, Kagera — nickel (completed)
- Kabanga, Kagera — lithium (partnership)
- Geita Gold Project, Geita — gold, with African Underground Mining Services (completed)
- Ikungi, Singida — lithium, with Tanzania Lithium (completed)
- Mahonga, Dodoma — lithium (completed)
- Mkunazi, Morogoro — limestone (completed; seeking strategic partner)
- Manga Gold Project, Tanga — gold, with MSA (partnership)
- Handeni Gold Project, Tanga — gold, with EMG Pamoja Royalty (partnership)

## Safety

Zero-harm culture with HSE practice aligned to ISO 9001 (quality), ISO 45001 (health and safety) and ISO 14001 (environment). Published figure: 1.2 million+ LTI-free man-hours.

## How to buy or enquire

Procurement and project teams should request a scoped proposal at https://geofields.co.tz/request-quote or email sales@geofields.co.tz. The team states it responds within one business day.
